data.name: Hotel Stardust
data.detailed_description:
Would you like to win $1,000,000? Survive the night at the Hotel Stardust, capture all anomalies, and the prize is yours. Be careful, some anomalies aren't very friendly.

Rules of the game

  • Walk. Observe. Compare against what you remember.

  • If something is different, capture it with your camera.

  • If something is chasing you, shoot it with your camera, then run.

  • If nothing is wrong…are you sure? Then head into the loop.

Your camera keeps the score

The camera is your only tool. Photograph all anomalies in the room and the door to the loop will open. Photograph something that was always there and the camera breaks. Nothing wrong at all? Keep your camera down and open the door into the loop to see if you're right.

Features

  • Dozens of handcrafted anomalies, from subtle out-of-place changes to full set-piece scares. No two runs play the same.

  • Photograph to win: capture real anomalies, but a false positive breaks your camera. Mistakes don't end the night, but they decide what kind of ending you get.

  • Some anomalies don't want you there. Getting caught starts the night over.

The Hotel Stardust is waiting. The prize is real. Check in whenever you're ready.

Two-Player Online Co-op

The Stardust takes guests in pairs too. Bring a friend.

House rules for couples:

  • One shot of film each per round. Some rounds hide more than one anomaly. Collaborate to clear them out.

  • A broken camera isn't the end. If your partner still has film, the round can still be saved.

  • The door opens together or not at all. When you both believe the round is over, you commit as a pair. Both hands on the door.

  • If something hunts you, formalities are off. Photograph it mid-chase and make sure both of you get through the door.

  • Only getting caught ends the night. Wrong photos and missed anomalies don't reset the run, but if either of you are caught, the night starts over for both.

Co-op is online for two players, invite a friend through Steam. Prefer to check in alone? The full game is also built for solo play.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (version 2004 or newer)
  • Processor: Intel i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 6GB / Radeon RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a DirectX 12 GPU with Shader Model 6 support (GeForce GTX 10-series / Radeon RX 400-series or newer). SSD recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit (version 2004 or newer)
  • Processor: Intel i7-9700 / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3070 / Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a DirectX 12 GPU with Shader Model 6 support (GeForce GTX 10-series / Radeon RX 400-series or newer). SSD recommended.
